description: Source code for the RecordBufferConverter class, which handles audio buffer format conversion, resampling, and channel/mode adjustments within the Android audio processing framework.

classes.name: RecordBufferConverter
classes.description: Handles conversion of audio buffers between different formats, channel configurations, and sample rates, including resampling and legacy mode handling.

methods.name: RecordBufferConverter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the converter with source and destination audio parameters.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs conversion of audio data, with or without resampling, from a provider to a destination buffer.

methods.name: updateParameters
methods.description: Updates internal parameters based on new source/destination formats, channels, and sample rates.

methods.name: convertNoResampler
methods.description: Converts audio data without resampling, handling legacy upmix/downmix and channel mask conversions.

methods.name: convertResampler
methods.description: Converts audio data using the resampler, handling channel and format conversions.
